content.what_it_is: MATLAB subgrid-block bathymetry generator. It creates a 500-by-30 coarse plane beach with a toe at x=560 m (L2-L19), defines 4-by-4 subcells with centered 3-by-3 top offsets and a 100-by-30 block region starting at coarse cell (400,1) (L21-L43), expands coarse depth to a 2000-by-120 fine grid and overlays subcell blocks while recording per-cell values (L45-L77). It clips negative fine depths only for coarse averaging, computes dep_sub, plots both grids, and writes coarse/fine depth plus dep_sub_info.txt (L79-L113).
entities: x,y coarse coordinates and dep coarse bathymetry @L10-L16

equations.ref: replicate coarse cell to fine subcell
coarse average of clipped fine depths

unresolved: Two flattening/averaging formulas incorrectly assume square subcells. L72 advances each jj row by `cell_n` but indexes ii across `cell_m`; the row stride must be cell_m. L89 divides the cell sum by cell_m twice instead of cell_m*cell_n. Active cell_m=cell_n=4 masks both defects, but rectangular configurations corrupt metadata columns and coarse averages.
Block bounds are not validated against the coarse/fine grids or obs_m/obs_n against cell_m/cell_n. Parameter edits can drive j_coarse/i_coarse or n1:n2/m1:m2 out of range.
dep_bottom=9999 is defined at L26 but never used. dep_top is added as an offset to local coarse depth at L64 rather than assigned as an absolute top elevation/depth; the intended meaning is unstated.

dep_level clips negative depths to zero only for dep_sub averaging (L79-L89), while dep_full and dep_sub_info retain negatives. Thus coarse and fine outputs are not direct conservative representations of one another around exposed blocks.
Hard-coded dimension-bearing filenames become stale if grid parameters change; plot directory and fopen success are unchecked.
